meaning_en: The joint connecting your foot and leg.
example_en: I hurt my ankle playing football.

meaning_en: The part of your body from shoulder to hand.
example_en: I hurt my arm playing tennis.

meaning_en: The part of your body opposite your stomach.
example_en: My back hurts after carrying heavy bags.

meaning_en: To cut or hold something with your teeth.
example_en: The dog tried to bite my hand.

meaning_en: To quickly close and open your eyes.
example_en: She blinked several times in the bright light.

meaning_en: The red liquid inside your body.
example_en: I saw some blood on my hand.

meaning_en: Clear your nose by forcing air through it.
example_en: He had a cold and had to blow his nose.

meaning_en: Your face turns red because you are embarrassed.
example_en: She blushed when he complimented her dress.

meaning_en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
example_en: Your body needs food and water.

meaning_en: The lowest part of something.
example_en: The book fell to the bottom of the stairs.

meaning_en: The organ inside your head that controls thought.
example_en: Your brain helps you think and learn new things.

meaning_en: Either of two soft parts on a woman's chest.
example_en: Babies drink milk from their mother's breast.

meaning_en: The air you take in and let out.
example_en: Take a deep breath and relax.

meaning_en: To take air in and let it out.
example_en: It's hard to breathe in this smoky room.

meaning_en: To take air into your lungs or push it out.
example_en: Breathe in slowly, then breathe out.

meaning_en: The soft part of your face below your eye.
example_en: She kissed her baby's soft cheek.

meaning_en: The front part of your body between your neck and stomach.
example_en: He felt a pain in his chest.

meaning_en: To break food into small pieces with your teeth.
example_en: Please chew your food slowly.

meaning_en: The part of your face below your mouth.
example_en: He has a small scar on his chin.

meaning_en: To make your hair neat with a comb.
example_en: Please comb your hair before school.

meaning_en: To push air from your lungs with a loud sound.
example_en: He started to cough because of the smoke.

meaning_en: To produce tears from your eyes, usually from sadness.
example_en: The baby started to cry loudly.

meaning_en: The part of your body for hearing.
example_en: I heard a noise with my ear.

meaning_en: The middle part of your arm where it bends.
example_en: I hit my elbow on the table.

meaning_en: The part of your body you see with.
example_en: I have blue eyes.

meaning_en: The front part of your head.
example_en: She has a happy face.

meaning_en: The parts of your body you stand on. (plural of foot)
example_en: My feet hurt after walking all day.

meaning_en: One of the five parts at the end of your hand.
example_en: I hurt my finger playing basketball.

meaning_en: To cross your arms over your chest.
example_en: He stood there with his arms folded.

meaning_en: The part of your leg you stand on.
example_en: My foot hurts after running.

meaning_en: the part of your face above your eyes.
example_en: She touched her forehead.

meaning_en: to make lines on your forehead, showing anger.
example_en: She frowned when she heard the news.

meaning_en: a wide smile showing your teeth.
example_en: He gave a big grin when he saw me.

meaning_en: Fine threads growing on your head.
example_en: She has long brown hair.

meaning_en: The part of your arm with fingers.
example_en: She waved her hand.

meaning_en: The top part of your body.
example_en: My head hurts a little.

meaning_en: The organ that pumps blood.
example_en: Your heart beats all the time.

meaning_en: The back part of your foot.
example_en: My new shoes hurt my heels.

meaning_en: The part of your body above your leg.
example_en: She put her hands on her hips.

meaning_en: To stop breathing for a short time.
example_en: I can hold my breath for a minute.

meaning_en: The middle joint of your leg.
example_en: I hurt my knee playing football.

meaning_en: To make sounds showing you find something funny.
example_en: We all laughed at his joke.

meaning_en: A part of the body used for walking.
example_en: I hurt my leg playing football.

meaning_en: Pass your tongue over something.
example_en: The dog licked my hand.

meaning_en: The edge of your mouth.
example_en: She bit her lip.

meaning_en: The two soft parts around your mouth.
example_en: She has red lips.

meaning_en: Colouring for your lips.
example_en: She put on red lipstick.

meaning_en: the part of your face used for eating
example_en: Open your mouth and say "Ah".

meaning_en: Hard part at the end of your finger or toe.
example_en: I broke my nail playing outside.

meaning_en: The part of the body connecting head and shoulders.
example_en: My neck hurts from sleeping badly.

meaning_en: Move your head up and down to say yes.
example_en: She nodded her head to agree.

meaning_en: The part of your face used for smelling.
example_en: I smell flowers with my nose.

meaning_en: Breathing fast and hard after exercise.
example_en: I ran so fast I was out of breath.

meaning_en: A bad feeling in your body when you are hurt.
example_en: I have a lot of pain in my leg.

meaning_en: Sweat; liquid from your skin when hot.
example_en: After running, I had a lot of perspiration.

meaning_en: To sweat; to produce liquid from your skin.
example_en: I always perspire when I exercise.

meaning_en: To make a deep, continuous, low sound.
example_en: My stomach started to rumble because I was hungry.

meaning_en: to move quickly from side to side or up and down
example_en: He shook his head in disagreement.

meaning_en: to greet someone by holding their hand
example_en: They shook hands after the meeting.

meaning_en: to move your head from side to side to say no
example_en: She shook her head, meaning "no".

meaning_en: to shake slightly because of cold or fear
example_en: I shivered in the cold wind.

meaning_en: The part of your body between your neck and arm.
example_en: He carried the bag on his shoulder.

meaning_en: A part of your body between your ribs and hip.
example_en: I have a pain in my side.

meaning_en: To breathe out slowly and loudly, showing relief or sadness.
example_en: She sighed with relief when she finished.

meaning_en: The outer covering of a person's body.
example_en: My skin is soft.

meaning_en: To make your mouth turn up at the corners.
example_en: She always smiles at me.

meaning_en: To suddenly push air from your nose and mouth.
example_en: I sneeze when I have a cold.

meaning_en: To make a loud noise while sleeping.
example_en: My husband often snores loudly.

meaning_en: The part of your body where food goes.
example_en: My stomach hurts after eating too much.

meaning_en: To pull liquid or air into your mouth.
example_en: The baby sucked its thumb for comfort.

meaning_en: To make food or drink go down your throat.
example_en: It was hard to swallow the large pill.

meaning_en: To produce liquid from your skin when hot or nervous.
example_en: I started to sweat during the intense workout.

meaning_en: To breathe in a lot of air.
example_en: Take a deep breath and relax.

meaning_en: Hard white parts in your mouth for eating.
example_en: Brush your teeth twice a day.

meaning_en: the short, thick finger on your hand.
example_en: I hurt my thumb playing basketball.

meaning_en: One of the five parts at the end of your foot.
example_en: I hurt my big toe on the table.

meaning_en: Hard white part in your mouth for chewing.
example_en: My baby brother has his first tooth.

meaning_en: To shake slightly, often from fear or cold.
example_en: Her hands began to tremble as she opened the letter.

meaning_en: The narrow part of your body between ribs and hips.
example_en: She tied a belt around her waist.

meaning_en: To clean something with water and soap.
example_en: Please wash your hands before dinner.

meaning_en: To move your hand to say hello or goodbye.
example_en: She waved to her friend across the street.

meaning_en: To close and open one eye quickly.
example_en: He winked at me to show it was a joke.

meaning_en: The joint connecting hand and arm.
example_en: I wear a watch on my wrist.

meaning_en: To open your mouth wide when tired.
example_en: He started to yawn because he was sleepy.
